Fixes correction learning in Electron and browser apps — Claude Desktop, Slack, VS Code, Chrome. These rebuild the text field's accessibility node the moment you start editing it, which killed the watcher exactly when you were typing the correction it was waiting for. The watcher now survives the rebuild, tolerates a glance at another window instead of giving up, and no longer spends its patience on the paste itself landing. A correction offer that would arrive while you're already dictating the next sentence is dropped rather than interrupting it.
